translations.web: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
translations.bsb: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west, nor out of the desert,
translations.kjv: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
translations.asv: For neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor yet from the south, cometh lifting up.
